['Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value', 'From activities', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', 'Join compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', 'Join molecule_dictionary on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', "Where activities.standard_relation = '='", '  and activities.pchembl_value is not null', "  and activities.bao_endpoint = 'IC50'", "  and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2171'", '  and target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606', "  and target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'", 'Order by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id', 'Limit 1000', 'Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value']
